payload.body: Threaded appId through ObjectStore + StreamStore read/write paths (trailing optional param, defaults '_default'). Reads filter by app_id; writes stamp it; cross-app object write rejected via new FrickCrossAppAccessError (objects PK doesn't include app_id, so guard the ON CONFLICT clobber). New app-id.ts mirrors tenant.ts. New app-scoping.test.ts proves read/list/delete isolation + write rejection + idempotency stamp. Gate: typecheck exit 0; server vitest 971 passed / 0 failed / 45 skipped (962+9). SCOPE NOTE: request-boundary appId resolution (gateway/server.ts) + non-core stores (blobs/presence/jobs/search/auth) left as follow-up; FR-38 + wider threading continue the epic.
